results.name: Create a draft
results.actual: HTTP 200 created the requested Draft with the 18:00 and 20:00 dates.

results.name: Require event name
results.actual: HTTP 422 returned title validation for the blank name.

results.name: Reject an end before start
results.actual: HTTP 422 rejected the 17:59 end with an 18:00 start.

results.name: Hide draft from guests
results.actual: Guest received HTTP 404 while the organizer received HTTP 200 with Draft.

results.name: Save free ticket settings
results.actual: A fresh authenticated GET confirmed FREE, quantity 5, limits 1–2 and Workshop quantity 3.

results.name: Publish and read public event
results.actual: Published Live; guest HTTP 200 included the matching title and Free ticket.

results.name: Edit live event description
results.actual: The updated description appeared publicly and General Admission remained available.

results.name: Unpublish and republish
results.actual: Guest responses were HTTP 200 → 404 → 200 across Live → Draft → Live.
